blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House committee on appropriations on Wednesday approved two measures in two separate hearings. The first one seeks to establish safety standards for the protection of children in social media and online gambling platforms. The second one aims to reorganize the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG).
